scope: Isolated headless Chrome, static UI fixture and injected wallet; no actual MetaMask, Flask-chain or public transaction claim.
checks: Multiple exposed accounts are visible, with only the first marked for actions.
Opening the disclosure makes no wallet request or account change.
A genuine fixture accountsChanged event updates both the action account and list order.
Additional provider values render as plain text without injected HTML.
Single-account wording and expanded 390px layout remain readable without horizontal overflow.
Disconnect and reload hide the disclosure and remove all previous accounts.
observationScope: Method recorder persists outside the page across reload.
